'''Star Tours Flight 1129''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. On the morning of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight's gate was changed to Gate 1E, where it was set to depart at 0820 hours.
